mapper.select:
select oc.id as id,oc.create_time as createTime,oc.role_code as roleCode,oc.data_id as dataId, jp.id as postId,jp.title as title,jp.user_id as userId,jp.settlement_type as settlementType,jp.type_ids as typeIds, jp.type_names as typeNames,jp.start_time as startTime,jp.end_time as endTime,jp.close_time as closeTime,jp.sex_require as sexRequire, jp.age_require as ageRequire,jp.recruits_number as recruitsNumber,jp.address_name as addressName,jp.address as address,jp.longitude as longitude, jp.phone as phone,jp.descr as descr,jp.pricing_mode as pricingMode,jp.salary as salary,jp.salary_unit as salaryUnit, jp.job_requires as jobRequires,jp.video_url as videoUrl,jp.img_url as imgUrl,jp.if_call as ifCall,jp.browse_number as browseNumber, jp.if_topping as ifTopping,jp.if_bold as ifBold,jp.post_status as postStatus, ( 6371* acos( cos( radians(#{params.latitude}) ) * cos( radians( jp.latitude ) ) * cos( radians( jp.longitude ) - radians(#{params.longitude}) ) + sin( radians(#{params.latitude}) ) * sin( radians( jp.latitude ) ) ) ) AS distance from job_browse oc left join job_post jp on jp.id=oc.data_id WHERE 1=1
AND oc.user_id = #{params.userId}
and ( jp.title like CONCAT('%',#{params.keyword},'%') or jp.descr like CONCAT('%',#{params.keyword},'%') )
order by oc.create_time desc
